items.title: koan-ansi v1.0.0 — KOAN.ansi 1.0.0
items.body:
Image & video → authentic BBS-scene ANSI art. First public release.

- **classic** (pure CP437, real .ans + SAUCE, iCE colors) and **extended** (unicode quarter blocks) charsets — pick per render, or `--charset both` for a side-by-side compare
- **vga16** (authentic DOS 16) and **truecolor** palettes
- **Ansimation (.ansim)** — the animated format: packed cell grids + fps, one JSON payload a web player loops (spec in the README)

## Video Dancer 0.4.0 — the Co-Director

This release adds an AI copilot to the NLE, rebuilds how project knowledge flows into prompts, and closes the loop between sketching and video generation.

items.title: KOAN-IMG v2.0.0-beta.3 — KOAN.img 2.0.0-beta.3
items.body: Windows installer (unsigned beta). On first launch SmartScreen warns: click More info then Run anyway. The app downloads its AI runtime (~2.7 GB) once on first run. Requires an NVIDIA CUDA GPU.
